summary: Diagnostic reproduction for reported 'Dashboard shows Complete Your Profile instead of Sophia overview' bug. BUG NOT REPRODUCED. In a fresh Playwright browser session, logging in as provider1@lumiere.com / sophia123 and clicking the top-nav Dashboard link renders the correct overview page ('Welcome, Sophia') with a live /api/providers/dashboard/stats 200 response containing profile.display_name='Sophia'. No JS console errors. pending_account_type is null. Strongly indicates the user's report is an environmental issue (stale browser cache / stale localStorage / logged into a different account), NOT a code bug.

api_capture.note: Endpoint was hit twice (React StrictMode double-invocation likely); both returned 200 with Sophia's full profile including provider_id=provider_024900f536dd, city=New York, rates, services, photos.

localStorage.note: No auth token or pending_account_type in localStorage; auth is via httpOnly session_token cookie as expected.

diagnostic_findings.console_errors: None observed during login → dashboard navigation.

issues: No visible 'Log out' link/menu in the top navigation when logged in as a provider. Only Browse/Dashboard/Advertise are shown. Users may struggle to sign out. Verify whether logout is intentionally hidden or should be surfaced (avatar menu, etc.).

action_items: No code fix needed for the reported dashboard bug — cannot reproduce in a fresh session. Recommend asking the reporting user to: (a) hard-refresh / clear site data, (b) confirm they are actually logged in as provider1@lumiere.com (not a different provider account without a profile), and (c) share a screenshot with the /dashboard URL + a screenshot of the network tab for /api/providers/dashboard/stats.
Consider adding a visible Logout affordance in SiteHeader when authenticated (minor UX).
critical_code_review_comments: ProviderDashboard.js: fetchDashboard() correctly sets mode='overview' when response.data.profile is truthy (line 332) and mode='create' when falsy (line 334). Logic is sound given the confirmed 200 response with profile.
ProviderDashboard.js is very large (2824 lines) — consider splitting into smaller focused files (create-form, overview, services, rates, availability sub-components).

profileData initial state reads localStorage.getItem('pending_account_type') (line 67) — harmless here because the create UI only shows when mode==='create'. However, in the isNewAgencyProfile branch it forces mode='create' without fetching /stats, which is expected. Not related to reported bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reported bug 'Dashboard shows Complete Your Profile for Sophia' could NOT be reproduced. /dashboard correctly renders 'Welcome, Sophia' overview and GET /api/providers/dashboard/stats returns 200 with populated profile. Screenshot saved at /app/.screenshots/sophia_dashboard.png. If the bug re-surfaces, first check: httpOnly session_token cookie is set for the correct user, and whether localStorage.pending_account_type or a stale account_type is causing an incorrect route in DashboardRouter (App.js).
rca of the issue: Root cause of the user-reported symptom is almost certainly environmental (stale browser cache/cookies or logged into a provider account that legitimately has no profile), not a code defect. Evidence: (1) fresh Playwright session with the exact stated credentials lands on /dashboard and renders 'Welcome, Sophia'; (2) /api/providers/dashboard/stats returns 200 with a full profile object; (3) code path in ProviderDashboard.fetchDashboard correctly branches on `response.data.profile` truthiness — with the observed 200 response, mode is set to 'overview' as designed; (4) localStorage.pending_account_type is null, so no create-mode override. Mitigation for the user: hard-refresh, clear site data / cookies, or open incognito and re-login.
